slowest_experiments.experiment: Claim-grade live ARC compaction generalization A/B

summary: The milestone completed 7 experiments in 1.4 minutes, including 3 compute-bound experiments. The longest listed compute-bound experiments took 0.49 and 0.29 minutes, and the locked compute-task GPU-idle indicator is false.
bottlenecks_identified: Exact source-grouped entrance constraint fixture formed the overall reported tail at 0.53 minutes; no phase data explains its duration.

Three-family SOTA entrance proposal bank and Claim-grade live ARC compaction generalization A/B were the longest listed compute-bound experiments at 0.49 and 0.29 minutes; no phase data explains their durations.
Disk-mtime reconstruction provides coarse elapsed times but no task-phase attribution, and the GPU snapshot is not correlated with individual compute-task windows.
improvements_suggested: Emit monotonic phase timings for setup, model load, inference, validation, and artifact write in every compute-task receipt.
Attach task-correlated GPU utilization samples to each compute-task receipt so an idle snapshot can be distinguished from idle execution.
Record simultaneous model count and runner selection at launch; select DualGPURunner only when at least 2 models run in parallel.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Add task-correlated phase and GPU telemetry to compute-task receipts.
Add a launch receipt that records simultaneous model count, device assignment, and runner selection.
Replace disk-mtime-only diagnosis with direct monotonic task timing while retaining the fallback.
meta_reflection: Execution was brief, but the fallback timing and standalone GPU snapshot do not explain where compute time was spent. Instrument the launch and task phases before claiming a measured speedup or a missed parallel-runner opportunity.
